g.title: ActivitySelection
g.text: Course Academy - current queue decision process

g.title: cluster_inputs
g.text: Read and interpret this account's queue

g.title: cluster_choice
g.text: Choose the first matching branch - stop evaluating once selected

g.title: cluster_selected
g.text: A. Finish the selected result and check it before Start

g.title: cluster_none
g.text: B. No fresh activity could be selected

g.title: Begin
g.text: A fresh queue selection is needed
Run independently for each signed-in account

g.title: Boundary
g.text: A saved run already chosen for resumption bypasses this ranking.
This chart ends at the activity handoff; capture and import follow later.

a.xlink:title:
Read /learn in displayed queue order
Visible unlocked cards: #incompleteTasks .taskUnlocked
Read type, task/topic IDs, Start link, and progress
Expand assessment details and missing diagnostic/multistep links
a.text: Read /learn in displayed queue order
Visible unlocked cards: #incompleteTasks .taskUnlocked
Read type, task/topic IDs, Start link, and progress
Expand assessment details and missing diagnostic/multistep links

g.title: ForcedResume
g.text: Restore its saved capture if available
Otherwise retain failure evidence for recovery

g.title: Metadata
g.text: Read Questions, Time limit, Notes, and retake title

a.xlink:title: ASSESSMENT CLASSIFICATION (first matching rule)\l1. Notes: optional until N more XP -> optional when N > 0; required at 0\l2. Notes: required / must take or complete -> required\l3. No Notes + sole queue card + complete details -> required\l4. Otherwise -> unknown\l\lRetake: title ends '(Retake)' or Notes say 'quiz retake'.\lComplete details: positive integer Questions and Time limit in minutes.\lA retake with optional/unknown status needs complete details to start.\l
a.text: ASSESSMENT CLASSIFICATION (first matching rule)
1. Notes: optional until N more XP -> optional when N > 0; required at 0
2. Notes: required / must take or complete -> required
3. No Notes + sole queue card + complete details -> required
4. Otherwise -> unknown
Retake: title ends '(Retake)' or Notes say 'quiz retake'.
Complete details: positive integer Questions and Time limit in minutes.
A retake with optional/unknown status needs complete details to start.

g.title: History
g.text: Read local history + MA completed Lesson/Review outcomes
Exclude all task IDs already saved, captured, or observed completed
Update pending perfect retakes from negative-XP Lesson/Review outcomes

g.title: TopicRules
g.text: Normally exclude a topic with a successfully captured Lesson.
Allow it again when a pending perfect Lesson retake exists, OR
a verified fresh assignment has a new task ID, zero progress,
and matching card ID, Start ID, and canonical Lesson URL.
Keep other old tasks for that topic excluded.
Completed Lesson topics do not exclude Reviews or Multisteps.

a.xlink:title: Tests used for the final inspection branch are fresh and uncaptured, but need not be capture_supported.
a.text: Identify fresh candidates
Supported type and matching Start URL; not in progress
Task ID not excluded; Lesson topic allowed
Retain nonoptional Assessments that fail selection for inspection

g.title: P4
g.text: Ties: smallest MA topic ID, then Lesson over Review
If still tied, first in queue

g.title: P5
g.text: Fallback when no Lesson/Review was ranked

g.title: P6
g.text: Select first remaining activity in queue
Multisteps enter here; they are not priority-ranked

g.title: P7
g.text: Select first optional Assessment as fallback
Record excluded task IDs for the Start recheck

g.title: Inspect
g.text: Includes unknown requirement or unsupported required test
Save selection; report in dry-run, otherwise defer before Start

a.xlink:title: HOW LESSON / REVIEW SCORES ARE CALCULATED\lRead-only inputs from math: learner targets, incomplete assignments,\learliest due dates, topic/next and KP key-prerequisite links.\lUse this capture account's latest saved course-progress snapshot.\l\lOnly self-directed mode contributes targets and assignments.\lFor each target, walk backward through prerequisites; stop expanding\la topic when all its observed progress bands are nonzero.\l\lEvery queued Lesson/Review topic starts at score 1.\lIf it supports targets, add:\l 1000c/(1+c) + 100/(1+r) + 100/(1+d)\lIf a supporting target has a due date, also add:\l 250/(1+h/24)\lc = number of supported targets\lr = smallest remaining unready-topic count among those target walks\ld = shortest distance to a supported target\lh = whole hours until earliest due date, floored at zero\l\lThese computed scores replace stored task scores for queued topics.\lNo effective self-directed targets (including assignments) -> score 1.\lThen the topic-ID tie-break determines the Lesson/Review choice.\lNormal queued Lessons/Reviews therefore have scores; unranked\lbranches are fallbacks. No learner-state writes or eligibility simulation.\l
a.text: HOW LESSON / REVIEW SCORES ARE CALCULATED
Read-only inputs from math: learner targets, incomplete assignments,
earliest due dates, topic/next and KP key-prerequisite links.
Use this capture account's latest saved course-progress snapshot.
Only self-directed mode contributes targets and assignments.
For each target, walk backward through prerequisites; stop expanding
a topic when all its observed progress bands are nonzero.
Every queued Lesson/Review topic starts at score 1.
If it supports targets, add:
If a supporting target has a due date, also add:
c = number of supported targets
r = smallest remaining unready-topic count among those target walks
d = shortest distance to a supported target
h = whole hours until earliest due date, floored at zero
These computed scores replace stored task scores for queued topics.
No effective self-directed targets (including assignments) -> score 1.
Then the topic-ID tie-break determines the Lesson/Review choice.
Normal queued Lessons/Reviews therefore have scores; unranked
branches are fallbacks. No learner-state writes or eligibility simulation.

g.title: Selected
g.text: Attach all_correct for a matching pending Lesson/Review perfect retake
This changes its answer policy, not its selection priority
Save selected task, reason, priority, exclusions, and queue evidence

g.title: Recheck
g.text: Read this Assessment's live details again
For optional fallback, recheck that no fresh supported
Lesson/Review/Multistep or other eligible Assessment exists
Honor the saved excluded task IDs

g.title: Defer
g.text: Save the reason for eligibility/layout recovery

g.title: Handoff
g.text: Hand off to its capture workflow

g.title: Recovery
g.text: If eligible, inspect one outstanding capture failure,
then refresh the queue and repeat selection once
If a candidate appears, continue at A

g.title: Resume
g.text: Resume first eligible saved capture in queue order
Skip already-resumed, completed, superseded, or deferred failures
Reuse its saved task identity and checkpoint

g.title: Wait
g.text: Work remains, but cannot start yet

g.title: Finish
g.text: Queue empty, or dry-run found no candidate

g.title: Legend
g.text: Solid arrows: decision flow; dotted: supporting inputs
Green: selected activity; amber: inspect / recover / wait
A and B: continue at the matching section below
Queue order means Math Academy's displayed card order
